control_name: Policy APIs align to the ACORD reference model (ADAPT)
control_objective: Every policy API endpoint exposed by the organization aligns to the ACORD reference model and the ACORD ADAPT API patterns so that partners can integrate against standard, predictable insurance entities.
risk_addressed: Policy API endpoints that diverge from the ACORD reference model force partners into bespoke integrations, fragment the canonical entity model, and accumulate integration debt that slows partner onboarding and increases defect rates.

required_data_elements.business_definition: A published policy API endpoint and its request/response contract from the API gateway.
The mapping from an API endpoint and its payload to ACORD reference-model entities.

method.summary: Compare every policy API endpoint against the ACORD reference model and confirm each maps to ACORD entities with no divergence.
steps: Enumerate published policy API endpoints from the API gateway.
Resolve each endpoint's mapping to ACORD reference-model entities.
Flag endpoints that diverge from the ACORD reference model.
Compute the percentage of endpoints mapped to ACORD entities.
method.fallback_logic: If either source is unavailable, mark Not Run and raise a Missing Source item rather than passing.

thresholds.materiality_basis: Any endpoint diverging from the ACORD reference model is a conformance exception.
thresholds.warning_threshold: Any endpoint not yet mapped to ACORD entities

pass_criteria: No endpoints diverge from the ACORD reference model.
All endpoints map to ACORD entities.
warning_criteria: Some endpoints are not yet mapped to ACORD entities.
fail_criteria: One or more endpoints diverge from the ACORD reference model.
exception_handling: Refactor the endpoint contract to the ACORD reference model and re-test.

assertions.description: No endpoints diverge from the ACORD reference model.
All endpoints mapped to ACORD entities.

downstream_linkage.staleness_rule: Must be re-evidenced each release before partner-facing APIs are promoted.

actions_on_fail: Notify API Product Owner and Integration Architect
